scope: Actual read pump uses NextReader plus bounded assembly rather than leaving an incomplete ReadMessage under indefinitely renewable Pong liveness.
Each started logical message has a fixed ten-second assembly window. An earlier idle deadline still takes precedence; admitted Pongs renew only idle liveness.
After a complete message, restore the existing idle/Pong deadline rather than granting a fresh idle window for every data message.
Retain Gorilla's 8192-byte logical-message limit, shared Ping/Pong count/byte budgets, default Ping replies, parsing/permissions and transport-retirement handoff.

checks.deadlineSelection: Idle-only, fixed assembly and earlier-idle precedence checked.
checks.actualFragmentedCompletion: Masked text/continuation frames with an empty continuation and interleaved Ping/Pong preserve the exact payload, default Pong response and next idle read beyond the prior assembly window.
checks.actualFragmentedSizeLimit: A payload split across 125-byte wire fragments is rejected by the existing 8192-byte logical-message limit.
checks.actualReadPumpIncompleteMessage: An unfinished empty data frame plus empty continuation/Pong pairs every100ms closes after the actual ten-second production assembly window, without exceeding count or byte budgets. Transport-closed state and unregister handoff verified.

limits: New actual loopback read-pump/fragment tests, not a new authenticated production-binary/database/session deployment acceptance.
Fixed assembly duration does not account for each raw continuation frame or provide raw-transport/compression-overhead, HTTP or upstream/global denial-of-service protection.
Ordinary idle behavior remains governed by the existing Pong policy. No account ban, IP household penalty, currency, gameplay or reward change.
Worker admission, jump policy, latest-source connected route/load evidence and other roadmap gates remain open. This does not complete milestone1.72.
